scope: Standing heritage exteriors of the Parramatta Female Factory and adjacent former Roman Catholic Orphan School and Parramatta Girls Home, including the two original sandstone ranges, penitentiary dormitory, solitary-cell enclosure wall, the school’s main building and its covered way and southwest range.

originalReview.notes: Augustus Earle’s circa 1826 watercolour is the exact original already published in Qualla. The right-hand penitentiary and the original outbuildings inform period fabric. The central barracks were demolished in the 1880s and are excluded from the standing scene. Its painted distances and earlier roof forms are approximate.
